ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Venus

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Thank someone who supports you and rarely hears a thank-you.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Take a real lunch break, without screens.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up home and family.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, family and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.
Until {H:1800961942000}, the Moon is still in {S:5} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The sextile between Mercury and Venus brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Venus brings affection and harmony. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.
